title: Aviation
overview: We advise airlines, operators, lessors, lenders, airports and service businesses. Our lawyers work with the rules of the Nigerian Civil Aviation Authority and the contracts that keep aircraft flying.

title: Construction
overview: We advise employers, contractors, designers and lenders on building and engineering projects. We prepare contracts that set out clearly who does what, when and for how much.

title: Energy and Utilities
overview: We advise power producers, distributors, suppliers and their customers. We help clients work with the licensing and tariff rules of the sector regulator.

title: Financial Services and Fintech
overview: We advise banks, lenders, payment companies, investment firms and start-ups in a closely regulated sector. We help new businesses understand which licences they need before they launch.

title: Infrastructure and Projects
overview: We advise governments, sponsors, contractors and lenders on large projects. We help structure the project, allocate risk and keep it within the law.

title: Life Sciences and Healthcare
overview: We advise hospitals, clinics, pharmaceutical businesses, medical device suppliers and health technology companies. We help clients work within the rules of regulators such as NAFDAC.

title: Manufacturing and Industrials
overview: We advise manufacturers, processors and industrial businesses. We help with the contracts, land, people and rules that a factory depends on.

title: Media, Sports and Entertainment
overview: We advise creators, producers, broadcasters, athletes, event organisers and the businesses around them. We help protect rights and agree fair terms.

title: Mining and Minerals
overview: We advise licence holders, investors, processors and buyers of minerals. We help clients secure and keep their rights, and deal fairly with host communities.

title: Oil and Gas
overview: We advise operators, service companies, traders and investors in the upstream, midstream and downstream sectors. We work with the licensing and local content rules of the sector.

title: Private Equity and Venture Capital
overview: We advise investors, fund managers, founders and the companies they back. We help at every stage, from the first investment to the exit.

title: Real Estate and Data Centres
overview: We advise developers, investors, landlords, tenants, lenders and operators of data centres. We help with land title, planning, leases and the power and connection needs of data centres.
asks: data centre sites, power and customer contracts

title: Renewable Energy
overview: We advise developers, investors, lenders and users of solar, wind, hydro and other clean energy. We help projects get licensed, funded and contracted.

title: Retail, E-commerce and Consumer Goods
overview: We advise retailers, online sellers, brands and distributors. We help with trading terms, customer rules and brand protection.

title: Shipping and Maritime
overview: We advise ship owners, charterers, cargo owners, ports and financiers. We work with the rules of the Nigerian Maritime Administration and Safety Agency and with international shipping contracts.

title: Technology, AI and Digital Assets
overview: We advise technology companies, start-ups, platforms and investors, including businesses that build or use artificial intelligence and digital assets. We help clients stay on the right side of the rules as they change.

title: Telecommunications
overview: We advise network operators, tower and infrastructure companies, service providers and investors. We work with the rules of the Nigerian Communications Commission.

title: Transport and Logistics
overview: We advise transport operators, freight and logistics businesses, and the companies that rely on them. We help with contracts, licences and claims.

title: Agriculture and Food
overview: We advise farms, processors, traders and food businesses. We help with land, supply and sales contracts, product standards and funding.

title: Education, Public Sector and Non-profit
overview: We advise schools, universities, public bodies, foundations and charities. We help with governance, funding and the rules that apply to organisations that serve the public.
